Docs / REVIEW & SHARE

Review and share your work

Check the details and choose where approvals belong in your workflow.

On this pageDecide what needs your reviewStart with the factsMake feedback actionableCheck the destination before approvingShare through your workflowKeep useful context for next time

Decide what needs your review

Assistant and Co-pilot ask before external or irreversible actions. Autopilot can publish automatically when your effective settings permit it. Keep any action, channel, or product that needs a person’s decision set to Needs approval.

Choose your level of autonomy →

Start with the facts

Check every product claim against a current source. Pay particular attention to numbers, dates, supported integrations, and promises about what a feature does. Product context helps ground a draft; an editor still needs to check it.

Make feedback actionable

Explain the change you want and why. “Replace the opening with a concrete customer problem” gives a clearer revision target than “make it punchier.” Review the revised version before moving it forward.

Check the destination before approving

Approval can do more than change a status. Depending on your workspace and the content type, it may trigger publishing or create a pull request. Confirm the configured destination and action before you approve.

For website articles, a configured GitHub repository and credentials can let Clara create a pull request for review in your existing workflow.

Share through your workflow

Use the publishing integrations available to your workspace, or export a supported format for your own process. A finished draft does not mean an account is connected or that a post has gone live. Check the outcome in the destination service.

Keep useful context for next time

When feedback reveals a recurring preference, add it to your brand guidelines or reusable instructions. When it reveals a factual gap, update the product sources. The next brief should start with that clearer context.
